# Engineering Handoff

`customer_support.escalation_and_incident.engineering_handoff` · v0.1.0 · **draft** · **STUB**

**Is this a defect engineering can actually act on, and who still owns the customer while they do?**


> Converting a customer's problem into something an engineering team can act on, and holding the customer relationship while they do. The boundary fails because the two sides optimise different things — support wants this customer unblocked today, engineering wants the defect class understood before touching it — and a handoff that does not translate between those gets politely triaged into a backlog and never seen again. A bug report that cannot be reproduced from its own text is a request for engineering to redo the work support already did, and it will be priced accordingly. The customer's ticket does not close when the bug is filed: ownership stays on the support side, because a filed bug with no support owner is how a customer becomes somebody else's forgotten backlog item.
